description: Native Enyo 16-bucket, 1280-hidden Bullet/SF-binpack smoke. This isolates hidden-width capacity against the prior 16-bucket/1024 baseline.

metadata.hypothesis: Keeping the clean 16-bucket Enyo runtime layout but widening the hidden layer from 1024 to 1280 may improve broad move-choice without changing feature geometry.
constraints: runtime buckets must match the 16-bucket Enyo engine
1280 hidden is compile-time selected in the engine, not runtime-dispatched

validation.first_gate: checkpoint sweep at 0,512,1024,1536,2048 on the 800-target lichess policy gate using the 1280-hidden engine
validation.promotion: no SPRT unless checkpoint gate is materially better than the 1024-hidden 16-bucket smoke and failure replay is clean
